+LONGS_WITH_VALUE = {"classify", "color", "colour", "icons", "width", "absolute", "level", "sort", "ignore-glob", "time", "time-style", "color-scale", "colour-scale", "color-scale-mode", "colour-scale-mode"}

+def parse(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[Opts, list[str]]:
+    opts = Opts()
+    paths: list[str] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        if arg == "--":
+            paths.extend(argv[i + 1:])
+            break
+        if not arg.startswith("-") or arg == "-":
+            paths.append(arg)
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("--"):
+            nameval = arg[2:]
+            if "=" in nameval:
+                name, value = nameval.split("=", 1)
+            else:
+                name, value = nameval, None
+            canonical = {"colour": "color", "colour-scale": "color-scale", "colour-scale-mode": "color-scale-mode"}.get(name, name)
+            if canonical in LONGS_WITH_VALUE and value is None:
+                if canonical in {"classify", "color", "icons"}:
+                    value = "auto"
+                else:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        raise CliError(f"Option --{name} needs a value")
+                    value = argv[i]
+            apply_long(opts, canonical, value)
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        shorts = arg[1:]
+        j = 0
+        while j < len(shorts):
+            ch = shorts[j]
+            value = None
+            if ch in SHORTS_WITH_VALUE:
+                if j + 1 < len(shorts):
+                    value = shorts[j + 1:]
+                    j = len(shorts)
+                else:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        raise CliError(f"Option -{ch} needs a value")
+                    value = argv[i]
+            apply_short(opts, ch, value)
+            j += 1

+        case "only-files": o.only_files = True
+        case "show-symlinks": o.show_symlinks = True
+        case "no-symlinks": o.no_symlinks = True
+        case "level": o.level = parse_int(value or "", "--level")
+        case "reverse": o.reverse = True
+        case "sort": set_sort(o, value or "")

+        case "ignore-glob": o.ignore_globs.extend((value or "").split("|"))
+        case "classify": o.classify = value or "auto"
+        case "color": o.color = value or "auto"
+        case "header": o.header = True
+        case "bytes": o.bytes = True
+        case "binary": o.binary = True
+        case "group": o.no_group = False
+        case "numeric": o.numeric = True
+        case "no-permissions": o.no_permissions = True
+        case "no-filesize": o.no_filesize = True
+        case "no-user": o.no_user = True
+        case "no-time": o.no_time = True
+        case "stdin": o.stdin = True
+        case "absolute": o.absolute = value or "on"
+        case "follow-symlinks": o.follow_symlinks = True
+        case "git" | "no-git" | "git-repos" | "git-repos-no-status" | "icons" | "width" | "hyperlink" | "dereference" | "color-scale" | "color-scale-mode" | "links" | "inode" | "blocksize" | "modified" | "accessed" | "created" | "changed" | "time" | "time-style" | "total-size" | "octal-permissions" | "mounts" | "smart-group" | "extended" | "context" | "flags" | "no-quotes":
+            return
+        case _:
+            raise CliError(f"Unknown option --{name}")
+
+
+def apply_short(o: Opts, ch: str, value: str | None):
+    match ch:
+        case "?": print(HELP, end=""); raise SystemExit(0)
+        case "v": print(VERSION, end=""); raise SystemExit(0)
+        case "1": o.mode = "lines"
+        case "l": o.long = True; o.mode = "long"
+        case "G" | "x": o.mode = "lines"
+        case "R": o.recurse = True
+        case "T": o.tree = True; o.recurse = True
+        case "a": o.all_count += 1
+        case "A": o.all_count = max(o.all_count, 1)
+        case "d": o.treat_dirs_as_files = True
+        case "D": o.only_dirs = True
+        case "f": o.only_files = True
+        case "L": o.level = parse_int(value or "", "-L")
+        case "r": o.reverse = True
+        case "s": set_sort(o, value or "")
+        case "I": o.ignore_globs.extend((value or "").split("|"))
+        case "F": o.classify = value or "auto"
+        case "b": o.binary = True
+        case "B": o.bytes = True
+        case "g": o.no_group = False
+        case "h": o.header = True
+        case "n": o.numeric = True
+        case "X" | "w" | "H" | "i" | "S" | "t" | "m" | "u" | "U" | "o" | "M" | "@" | "Z" | "O":
+            return
+        case _:
+            raise CliError(f"Unknown option -{ch}")
+
+
+def parse_int(s: str, opt: str) -> int:
+    try:
+        return int(s)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise CliError(f"Value {s!r} not valid for option {opt}: invalid digit found in string")
+
+
+def set_sort(o: Opts, value: str):
+    if value not in SORT_FIELDS:
+        raise CliError(f"Option --sort has no {value!r} setting")
+    o.sort = {"date": "modified", "time": "modified", "old": "oldest", "new": "newest"}.get(value, value)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: Path
+    display: str
+    st: os.stat_result | None
+    lst: os.stat_result | None
+    missing: bool = False
+
+    @property
+    def name(self) -> str:
+        return self.path.name or str(self.path)
+
+    @property
+    def is_link(self) -> bool:
+        return self.lst is not None and stat.S_ISLNK(self.lst.st_mode)
+
+    @property
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return self.path.is_dir()
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    @property
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        return self.st is not None and stat.S_ISREG(self.st.st_mode)
+
+
+def make_entry(path: Path, display: str | None = None) -> Entry:
+    try:
+        lst = path.lstat()
+        st = path.stat()
+        return Entry(path, display if display is not None else str(path), st, lst)
+    except OSError:
+        return Entry(path, display if display is not None else str(path), None, None, True)
+
+
+def visible_name(e: Entry, opts: Opts, link_paths: bool = True) -> str:
+    if opts.absolute == "on":
+        base = str(e.path.resolve(strict=False))
+    else:
+        base = e.display
+    if link_paths and e.is_link:
+        try:
+            base += " -> " + os.readlink(e.path)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    if opts.classify == "always":
+        if e.is_dir:
+            base += "/"
+        elif e.is_link:
+            base += "@"
+        elif e.st and (e.st.st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR):
+            base += "*"
+    return base
+
+
+def should_skip_name(name: str, opts: Opts) -> bool:
+    if opts.all_count == 0 and name.startswith("."):
+        return True
+    return any(pat and fnmatch.fnmatch(name, pat) for pat in opts.ignore_globs)
+
+
+def list_dir(path: Path, opts: Opts) -> list[Entry]:
+    entries: list[Entry] = []
+    if opts.all_count >= 2:
+        entries.extend([make_entry(path / ".", "."), make_entry(path / "..", "..")])
+    try:
+        names = list(os.listdir(path))
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise exc
+    for name in names:
+        if should_skip_name(name, opts):
+            continue
+        e = make_entry(path / name, name)
+        if filtered(e, opts):
+            continue
+        entries.append(e)
+    return sort_entries(entries, opts)
+
+
+def filtered(e: Entry, opts: Opts) -> bool:
+    is_link = e.is_link
+    is_dir = e.is_dir
+    is_file = e.is_file
+    if opts.no_symlinks and is_link:
+        return True
+    if opts.only_dirs and not is_dir:
+        return True
+    if opts.only_files and not is_file and not (opts.show_symlinks and is_link):
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts) -> list[Entry]:
+    def key(e: Entry):
+        dir_group = 0
+        if opts.dirs_first:
+            dir_group = 0 if e.is_dir else 1
+        elif opts.dirs_last:
+            dir_group = 1 if e.is_dir else 0
+        sf = opts.sort
+        if sf in {"none"}:
+            val = 0
+        elif sf == "size":
+            val = e.st.st_size if e.st else -1
+        elif sf in {"modified", "newest"}:
+            val = -(e.st.st_mtime if e.st else 0)
+        elif sf == "oldest":
+            val = e.st.st_mtime if e.st else 0
+        elif sf in {"extension", "Extension"}:
+            ext = e.name.rsplit(".", 1)[1] if "." in e.name else ""
+            val = (ext if sf == "Extension" else ext.lower(), e.name.lower())
+        elif sf == "type":
+            val = (0 if e.is_dir else 1 if e.is_file else 2, e.name.lower())
+        elif sf == "Name":
+            val = e.name
+        else:
+            val = e.name.lower()
+        return (dir_group, val, e.name.lower())
+    out = sorted(entries, key=key)
+    if opts.reverse:
+        out.reverse()
+    return out
+
+
+def mode_string(e: Entry) -> str:
+    if e.st is None:
+        return "?????"
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        first = "d" if e.is_dir else "l" if e.is_link else "-"
+        readonly = bool(e.st.st_file_attributes & getattr(stat, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY", 1)) if hasattr(e.st, "st_file_attributes") else False
+        return first + ("-" if readonly else "a") + "---"
+    m = e.st.st_mode
+    first = "d" if stat.S_ISDIR(m) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(m) else "-"
+    bits = ""
+    for r, w, x in [(stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)]:
+        bits += "r" if m & r else "-"
+        bits += "w" if m & w else "-"
+        bits += "x" if m & x else "-"
+    return first + bits
+
+
+def size_string(e: Entry, opts: Opts) -> str:
+    if e.st is None or e.is_dir:
+        return "-"
+    n = e.st.st_size
+    if opts.bytes or n < 1000:
+        return str(n)
+    units = [(10**12, "T"), (10**9, "G"), (10**6, "M"), (10**3, "k")]
+    if opts.binary:
+        units = [(1024**4, "T"), (1024**3, "G"), (1024**2, "M"), (1024, "K")]
+    for div, suf in units:
+        if n >= div:
+            v = n / div
+            return (f"{v:.1f}" if v < 10 else str(round(v))) + suf
+    return str(n)
+
+
+def time_string(e: Entry) -> str:
+    if e.st is None:
+        return "-"
+    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(e.st.st_mtime)
+    return f"{dt.day:2d} {dt.strftime('%b')} {dt.year:5d}"
+
+
+def long_rows(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts) -> list[list[str]]:
+    rows: list[list[str]] = []
+    if opts.header:
+        h = []
+        if not opts.no_permissions: h.append("Mode" if os.name == "nt" else "Permissions")
+        if not opts.no_filesize: h.append("Size")
+        if not opts.no_user: h.append("User")
+        if not opts.no_group: h.append("Group")
+        if not opts.no_time: h.append("Date Modified")
+        h.append("Name")
+        rows.append(h)
+    for e in entries:
+        r = []
+        if not opts.no_permissions: r.append(mode_string(e))
+        if not opts.no_filesize: r.append(size_string(e, opts))
+        if not opts.no_user: r.append(user_string())
+        if not opts.no_group: r.append(group_string())
+        if not opts.no_time: r.append(time_string(e))
+        r.append(visible_name(e, opts, True))
+        rows.append(r)
+    return rows
+
+
+def user_string() -> str:
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        return ""
+    try:
+        import pwd
+        return pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name
+    except Exception:
+        return str(os.getuid() if hasattr(os, "getuid") else "")
+
+
+def group_string() -> str:
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        return ""
+    try:
+        import grp
+        return grp.getgrgid(os.getgid()).gr_name
+    except Exception:
+        return str(os.getgid() if hasattr(os, "getgid") else "")
+
+
+def render_long(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts) -> str:
+    rows = long_rows(entries, opts)
+    if not rows:
+        return ""
+    cols = max(len(r) for r in rows)
+    widths = [0] * cols
+    for r in rows:
+        for i, c in enumerate(r):
+            widths[i] = max(widths[i], len(c))
+    lines = []
